title: API crashes after a deploy
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the API component, the missing package problem, and the new image/deploy as the trigger.
option_titles: Rollback API to previous working image
root_cause: The API container crashes on startup because the new image shopapp/api:2.3.2 is missing the pydantic_settings Python package required by the updated settings code, causing a ModuleNotFoundError and a continuous restart loop.
truth: api 2.3.2 imports the pydantic_settings library, but it isn't installed in the image, so the app crashes on start (exit code 1) and Docker keeps restarting it.
